claims.quote: When I came back to the ship the deck smelled different—sea and tar and the up-throb of men waiting for a rhythm—and the folio lay open on the hatch like a private thing left unattended.
Yusuf was already there, sleeves hitched, the map loosened between his palms as if he were balancing a thought.

They came in twos and threes, blinking the market dust from their eyes. Rasim pulled his coat tighter and coughed once as he took the top step, like a man testing whether he could keep standing if the world decided to press on him.
The folio lay open on the hatch like a private thing left unattended.
The wreck log lay beside the folio, folded smaller and worse for the sea.

The folio had been handled so much that the coastline had gone soft where hands had smudged it; there were crosses darkened into blurs and pencil lines that started with confidence and ended in a scrawl. It suggested navigation rather than instructions—finger-thin errors sketched in ink, not the sort of handwriting you followed without a rope and a prayer.
claims.value: marginalia and coastline notes concerning Isle Jarrah and hazards

claims.quote: The diagram in it had been eaten by a torn edge; what was left looked like a hand that had tried to keep something from going away. Words bled at their margins; an attempt at a phrase had been scrubbed to a smudge and the paper had the desperate weight of a man who had run out of time.
claims.value: suggests a loom at Isle Jarrah's heart and the centrality of a fate-loom

claims.quote: I felt the amulet at my throat prickle, a small and accurate pain.
claims.value: steal the spindle from Isle Jarrah

claims.quote: We prepared in the way that keeps a ship alive: the canvas rolled and lashed, lanterns trimmed so they would not gutter, a rope checked with a sailor's thumb.
Rasim pulled his coat tighter and coughed once as he took the top step, like a man testing whether he could keep standing if the world decided to press on him.
"Azraq can fasten the council to my throat," I said, "but he cannot fasten my crew to the deck. That's mine to keep."
claims.value: intends to keep command of the Qitaf and crew while undertaking the mission

claims.quote: Yusuf looked at the same blur and tapped the paper with a forefinger, as if feeling for the weakness of a seam. He folded the folio and slipped it under his arm like a thing to be guarded.
"We would leave at dawn," I told the men, the plan small and sharp.
